archetypes.name: count-audit
archetypes.rationale: The plan contains conflicting case counts (issue body says 16 cases, plan body says 21 new_case invocations, and the old doc row the plan targets reportedly says 18 cases) that are never reconciled; a correctness reviewer must verify the actual harness count before accepting any prose rewrite.
archetypes.prompt_body: Count every `new_case` invocation in `skills/implement/scripts/test-step-7a.sh` directly and compare against the three competing numbers in play: the issue body's '16 cases', the plan's '21 current new_case invocations', and the existing doc row's claimed count. Verify that the plan's case-to-prose mapping (green, diagram-skip, diagram-rejected, 4 sanitizer-skip variants, diagram-failure, diagram-failure-sanitizer, upsert-failure, flush-failure, flush-failure-no-logs-commit, no-logs-commit, forked-target, issue-empty, generator-crash, rebase-conflict, rebase-failed, rebase-unexpected-rc, quiet-rebase-contract, quiet-diagram-skip-contract, argv-error) exhausts the actual invocation set with no overcounting and no undercounting. Flag any discrepancy between the plan's claimed mapping and what the harness file contains. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
